messages:
maria: quick callout from onboarding tests — SDKs return different error shapes for the same runtime failure (py: AuthExpired, go: raw '401 Unauthorized', js: nested keys). this makes retry logic and UI messages fragile. can we land a tiny canonical error body + language-native typed exceptions?

alex: absolutely. runtime should emit a compact machine-readable JSON and SDKs map to native exceptions but keep the original body accessible. keeps ergonomics + debuggability. :thumbsup:

sam: propose minimal canonical fields: type, status, message, error_class, retryable, retry_after_seconds (optional), hint_code (optional), documentation_url (optional). small and actionable.

linda: agree. suggested error_class enums: auth, permission, rate_limit, user_input, not_found, conflict, transient_server. apps can switch on that instead of fragile status-code parsing.

maria: streaming corner case — mid-stream failures should include same canonical body + optional stream_resume_token/stream_offset. SDKs should raise a StreamInterruptedError with resume metadata.

qa-bot: test suggestion: add a CI matrix that posts canonical payloads (one per error_class) and asserts each SDK surfaces matching `error_class` and `retryable` and exposes `raw_error` on the exception. automate nightly.

maria: small UX copy note: separate developer logs and end-user copy. dev log: 'AuthError: token expired (401)'; UI string: 'Session expired — please sign in again.' keep user-facing messages curated in i18n docs.

alex: runtime mapping draft for the runtime team (informal): 400 -> user_input (retryable=false); 401/403 -> auth/permission (retryable=false); 404 -> not_found; 409 -> conflict; 429 -> rate_limit (retryable=true; use Retry-After header when present); 5xx -> transient_server (retryable=true).

sam: SDK ergonomics: each SDK should expose a language-idiomatic typed exception (e.g., RateLimitError) with properties: status (int), is_retryable (bool), raw_error (map/object/string). names are idiomatic per language but those properties must be present.

linda: add `hint_code` values like `refresh_token`, `backoff`, `reduce_concurrency` so UIs can show actionable buttons; `documentation_url` is handy for deep links.

maria: quick example for docs (dev-facing):

{
  "type": "RateLimitError",
  "status": 429,
  "message": "Too many requests",
  "error_class": "rate_limit",
  "retryable": true,
  "retry_after_seconds": 30,
  "hint_code": "reduce_concurrency",
  "documentation_url": "https://docs.redwood.ai/errors#rate-limit"
}

linda: love it. tiny nit: ensure SDKs expose the raw field names as `raw_error` (py dict, js object, go struct/map) so teams can inspect `hint_code` if needed.

maria: next steps: i'll draft an RFC with example patches for py/go/js and a small docs page. @alex want go/java? @linda want js/docs? @sam runtime tests?

alex: i'll take go & java SDK changes.

linda: happy to do js + docs.

sam: i'll owner runtime tests and CI gating.

maria: i'll open a tracking ticket and link RFC (DX-ERR-2910). thanks all :sparkles

jira-bot: Created ticket DX-ERR-2910: "Canonical SDK error body + language-idiomatic typed exceptions" and assigned to maria, alex, linda, sam.
